update.reason: No stable releases; track main with a dated version and immutable commit pin until upstream tags releases.

hardening.minimized_reason: No feature-minimization claim has been established for this package.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.

changes.what: postdoc for werewolf's postdoc-server form, as Wolfi would package it: built by melange in Wolfi's environment with Wolfi's Rust, from a commit on main, since postdoc tags no releases. Its engines (cleave, scan, isomer) come from git at the commits Cargo.lock pins. The allocator is the jemalloc linked into the binary, as on every host of the fleet. A new commit is a new version and expected-commit; howl rebuilds when this file changes.
changes.why: Provide an independently maintained application context with immutable sources and separately updatable Wolfi dependencies.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi provides equivalent packaging, supported versions, architectures and required hardening; review compatibility before retiring this context.
